exposure: MR scan timing (24-96 hours and 7-14 days after birth)
outcome: Neurodevelopmental impairment at 18-22 months of age
cohort: The study included 98 neonates (35-41 weeks of gestation) with neonatal encephalopathy who underwent therapeutic hypothermia.
finding: Deep gray matter tNAA concentration was identified as the most accurate quantitative MR biomarker for predicting adverse outcomes, particularly retaining high prognostic value in the second week of life.
